items.title: How much weight would long-term maintainability need before the recommendation flips?
items.description: L3's baseline weighting (0.20 on maintainability) has 'stay monolith, modular' beating 'extract 2 services now' by a real margin. The rest of the weight is held in the same relative proportions L3 used across operational risk, team familiarity, time-to-value, and cost as maintainability's own weight is dragged up or down. Drag the slider and watch the score gap -- a positive gap means 'extract now' has taken the lead.
items.compute: const wMaint = params.maintainabilityWeight; const remaining = 1 - wMaint; const cost = remaining * 0.125; const risk = remaining * 0.375; const familiarity = remaining * 0.3125; const timeToValue = remaining * 0.1875; const scoreA = 8 * cost + 8 * risk + 9 * familiarity + 4 * wMaint + 9 * timeToValue; const scoreB = 4 * cost + 5 * risk + 5 * familiarity + 9 * wMaint + 4 * timeToValue; return { gap: scoreB - scoreA };

outputs.label: Score gap: extract-now minus stay-monolith (positive means extract-now wins)
